name: get_trendbars
description: Get historical OHLCV candle data for a symbol. 'count' alone gives the last N bars. Pass fromTimestamp/toTimestamp for a specific window; it must not exceed 30 days, so longer histories need one call per 30-day window.

fromTimestamp.description: Start time (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Defaults to 30 days before toTimestamp. Range to-from must not exceed 30 days.

toTimestamp.description: End time (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Defaults to now.

count.description: Max bars, counted back from toTimestamp (default 100, clamped to 1000). It trims the window, never widens it: with D_1 the default 30-day window holds ~22 bars however large count is — widen fromTimestamp instead.
